relative_catch.code:
plot_relative_catch(b, observed = data.frame(year = b$year, catch = x$truth$CB), type = "weight", 
    observed_name = "Simulated catch")
relative_catch.note_zh: 只用调查指数拟合时，渔获量的绝对水平取决于假定的自然死亡率和调查可捕性，所以只比较趋势。点为生成数据时的渔获重量，不是报告的渔获统计。
relative_catch.note_en: A fit to a survey index alone has no information on the absolute level of catch, which depends on the assumed natural mortality rate and survey catchability, so only trends are compared. The points are the catch in weight of the data-generating simulation, not reported landings.

recruitment.note_zh: 补充量对应最小年龄组；受设定的补充年龄和时间步长影响。
recruitment.note_en: Recruitment enters the youngest age class; its interpretation depends on recruitment age and time step.

SSB_Rec.note_zh: 横轴与补充量错开 1 个观测步长。这里只画散点，不拟合资源补充函数。
SSB_Rec.note_en: Recruitment is shifted by one observation step. This is a scatter plot, not a fitted stock recruitment curve.

VB.note_zh: 实线为 ALSCL 拟合尾数算出的各年龄平均体长（各时间步的均值）；虚线为由 Linf、k 和 t0 计算的参考曲线，只在加 parameter_curve = TRUE 时绘制。点为模拟的年龄鉴定资料。
VB.note_en: The solid line is the mean length at age from the fitted numbers of the ALSCL fit (mean over the time steps). The dashed line is the curve computed from Linf, k and t0 and is drawn only with parameter_curve = TRUE. The points are synthetic age readings.

length_at_age.zh: 各时间步的年龄别平均体长
length_at_age.en: Mean length at age by time step
length_at_age.note_zh: 每个分面是一个年龄组。原始结构下第一个时间步的各年龄体长分布由 Linf、k 和 t0 给出，之后由生长增量和体长别死亡决定。
length_at_age.note_en: One panel per age class. With the original structure the length distribution of every age class in the first time step follows from Linf, k and t0; later time steps follow from the growth increments and mortality at length.

pla.note_zh: 颜色表示给定年龄时落入各体长组的概率。每列合计为 1，最高体长组包含该年龄体长分布的右尾。横轴为拟合年龄，最后一个年龄为 plus group（标为 15+）。
pla.note_en: Each column gives length-bin probabilities for one age and sums to one. The last bin includes the upper tail for that age. The x axis shows the fitted ages; the last age is the plus group (15+).

F_ACL_year.zh: ACL 各年龄组捕捞死亡率随时间的变化
F_ACL_year.en: ACL fishing mortality over time by age class

plot_fishing_mortality(fit, type = if (model == "ACL" && typ == "length") "age" else typ, se = TRUE, 
    facet_ncol = 4, line_size = 0.6)
F_ACL_year.note_zh: 年度示例的 F 为每年瞬时率；季度数据得到每季度率。不同模型的原生 F 维度不同。
F_ACL_year.note_en: F is an instantaneous rate per model step. Native F dimensions differ between the models.

inputs.zh: 拟合所用的自然死亡率和调查可捕性
inputs.en: Natural mortality rate and survey catchability used in the fit
inputs.code:
(plot_natural_mortality(b, line_size = 0.8) + labs(title = "Natural mortality rate (M)")) | 
    (plot_survey_catchability(b, line_size = 0.8, point_size = 1.5) + labs(title = "Survey catchability at length"))
inputs.note_zh: 两者都是用户给定的假设，不是估计值。调查指数不能确定总死亡中自然死亡的份额，也不能确定可捕性的水平。
inputs.note_en: Both are assumptions supplied by the user, not estimates. The survey index informs neither the share of natural mortality in total mortality nor the level of catchability.

residuals_length.zh: 按体长组分面的对数残差
residuals_length.code:
plot_residuals(b, facet_by = typ, facet_ncol = 4, x_breaks = if (typ == "length") c(2000, 2010, 
    2015) else c(10, 30, 50), line_size = 0.6)
residuals_length.note_zh: 观测对数减预测对数；未经标准差标准化。每个分面内，缺失或排除的观测会断开残差线和趋势线。单个有效观测画成点。连续 2–5 个观测用直线拟合趋势，连续至少 6 个观测用 loess。
residuals_length.note_en: Observed minus fitted log index, without standardization. Within each facet, a missing or excluded observation breaks the residual line and its trend. A single observed value is drawn as a point. Each consecutive run of 2–5 observations has a linear trend, and a run of 6 or more uses loess.

    2015) else c(10, 30, 50), line_size = 0.6)

residuals_year.note_en: Observed minus fitted log index, without standardization. Within each facet, a missing or excluded observation breaks the residual line and its trend. A single observed value is drawn as a point. Each consecutive run of 2–5 observations has a linear trend, and a run of 6 or more uses loess.

    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2000, 2010, 2019), expand = expansion(mult = 0.04))
deviation_R_TRUE.note_zh: 对数偏差为零时，原尺度上的值等于过程中位数。
deviation_R_TRUE.note_en: A zero log deviation corresponds to the process median on the original scale.

deviation_R_FALSE.zh: 补充量相对于中位数的倍数
deviation_R_FALSE.en: Recruitment relative to the process median

deviation_R_FALSE.note_en: Exponentiated deviations are ratios to the process median. Interval endpoints are exponentiated from the log scale.

ridges.note_zh: 每期分别归一化；左为观测，右为拟合。不能由此读出总丰度趋势。含已保存观测的结果可直接绘图。 缺失或被排除的体长组会断开观测轮廓和填色。孤立的观测体长组在缩放后的组成高度处画为点；归一化仍使用该期全部正观测。左右面板使用相同的时间位置、完整模型体长范围、纵轴范围和时间配色，包括完全缺测的时期。`spectral` 等 Brewer 配色也支持只有两个时期的结果。
ridges.note_en: Each period is normalized separately: observations left, fit right. This does not show total abundance trends. Saved results containing observations are supported. Missing or excluded length bins break the observed outline and fill. An isolated observed bin is drawn as a point at its scaled composition height; normalization still uses all positive observations in that period. Both panels keep the same time positions, full model length range, vertical range and time colors, including periods without observations. Brewer palettes such as `spectral` also support two-period results.

compare_ts.note_zh: 只比较共同输出与相同时间窗；自由纵轴不能直接比较不同量的振幅。
compare_ts.note_en: Compare common quantities over the same time window. Free y axes preclude amplitude comparisons across quantities.

compare_F.note_zh: ACL 纵轴是年龄，ALSCL 纵轴是长度；颜色可辅助观察，但两行不逐格对应。
compare_F.note_en: ACL uses age and ALSCL length on the vertical axis; cells do not correspond one to one.

compare_residuals.note_zh: 包括直方图、QQ 图、年度残差和长度组箱线图。年度误差棒是标准差，不是置信区间。 整期缺测会断开平均残差线，孤立的有效时期仍显示为点。只有该期至少有两个观测体长组时才绘制标准差误差棒；仅有一个观测时仍保留残差点。
compare_residuals.note_en: Includes histograms, QQ plots, annual residuals and length-bin boxplots. Annual error bars represent SD, not confidence intervals. A wholly unobserved period breaks the mean-residual line. Isolated observed periods remain visible as points. An SD bar is drawn only when the period contains at least two observed length bins; a single observation still contributes its residual point.

compare_growth.zh: 两模型的年龄别平均体长
compare_growth.en: Mean length at age of both models
compare_growth.code:
growth_display(plot_compare_growth(a, b, age_range = c(1, 15), ref_data = ref, ref_name = "Synthetic reference", 
    nls_start = list(Linf = 60, k = 0.2, t0 = 1/60)))
compare_growth.note_zh: 左图为两次拟合的年龄别平均体长（ACL 来自年龄—体长概率矩阵，ALSCL 来自拟合尾数），口径相同。灰色参照曲线来自模拟 Age 与 Length；不代表论文实测生长。ref_name 必须是非空名称，且与两个模型名称不同。
compare_growth.note_en: The left panel shows mean length at age of both fits on the same basis (ACL from its age-length key, ALSCL from its fitted numbers). The reference curve uses synthetic Age and Length data, not empirical measurements from the paper. ref_name must be nonempty and differ from both model names.

compare_CatL.code: plot_compare_CatL(a, b, dat, years = c(2000, 2005, 2010, 2015), facet_ncol = 2)
compare_CatL.note_zh: 显示 4 个指定年份；省略 years 将显示全部年份。点为调查数据，线为拟合中位数。纵轴为调查指数，不是捕获量；自定义标签使用 ylab$survey。
compare_CatL.note_en: Four selected years are shown. Omit years to show all periods. Points are observations and curves fitted medians. The vertical axis is a survey index, not catch abundance; use ylab$survey for a custom label.

compare_metrics.code:
plot_compare_metrics(a, b, dat, facet_ncol = 2) & scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 
    0.3)))
compare_metrics.note_zh: 当前数据由年龄模型生成。图示差异不能证明任一模型普遍较优；IC 还需要相同数据与似然口径。
compare_metrics.note_en: The generating model is age based. This comparison cannot establish universal superiority; information criteria also require comparable data and likelihoods.

compare_selectivity.note_zh: 当前函数展示输入 q 的连接线，不是估计的渔业选择性。两模型使用同一输入，曲线重合。
compare_selectivity.note_en: This function connects the input survey q; it does not estimate fishery selectivity. Identical inputs produce overlapping curves.

compare_F_apical.zh: 每个时间步的最大捕捞死亡率
compare_F_apical.en: Maximum fishing mortality by time step
compare_F_apical.code: plot_compare_F_ts(a, b, method = method) + labs(title = if (method == "apical") "Apical fishing mortality" else "Mean fishing mortality")
compare_F_apical.note_zh: apical 取最大值，mean 取组间算术平均，均非丰度加权。季度拟合按季度汇总，不做年化。
compare_F_apical.note_en: Apical is the maximum; mean is an unweighted group average. Quarterly fits are summarized per quarter; nothing is annualized.

compare_F_mean.zh: 每个时间步的平均捕捞死亡率
compare_F_mean.en: Mean fishing mortality by time step
compare_F_mean.code: plot_compare_F_ts(a, b, method = method) + labs(title = if (method == "apical") "Apical fishing mortality" else "Mean fishing mortality")
compare_F_mean.note_zh: apical 取最大值，mean 取组间算术平均，均非丰度加权。季度拟合按季度汇总，不做年化。
compare_F_mean.note_en: Apical is the maximum; mean is an unweighted group average. Quarterly fits are summarized per quarter; nothing is annualized.

retro_ACL.code: plot_retro(retro_a, facet_ncol = 2, rho_digits = 3, rho_size = 3, point_size = 1, line_size = 0.6)

retro_ALSCL.code: plot_retro(retro_b, facet_ncol = 2, rho_digits = 3, rho_size = 3, point_size = 1, line_size = 0.6)

truth.code:
ggplot(estimates, aes(Year, Value, color = Model)) + geom_line() + scale_color_manual(values = setNames(acl_theme("compare_colors"), 
    c("ACL", "ALSCL"))) + geom_line(data = truth, aes(Year, Truth), inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = 2) + 
    facet_wrap(~Quantity, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) + theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + labs(y = NULL)
truth.note_zh: 黑虚线为生成真值；固定生物参数，且模拟与拟合的补充过程不同。
truth.note_en: Black dashed curves are generating truth. Biology is fixed; recruitment processes differ.
